content.title: 2024 ESC Guidelines for the management of atrial fibrillation - Reviewers
content.note: Report lists declarations of interest as reported to the ESC by experts during the yearly call for declaration covering the previous calendar year. Calls for declaration conducted during development period up to and including 2023.
